leads.title: European Court of Human Rights - 2010 pride parade ruling (Alexeyev case)
leads.documents: Fined Russia for discriminating against LGBTQ community after local governments systemically refused permits for pride parades; documents enforcement/assembly rights machinery
leads.detail: Text cites: 'In 2010, the European Court of Human Rights fined Russia for discriminating against the LGBTQ community, after local governments systemically refused to issue permits to pride parades.' No URL visible in provided text.

leads.title: Federal law on propaganda of non-traditional sexual relationships (2013)
leads.documents: Criminalizes distribution of 'propaganda' promoting 'non-traditional sexual relationships' among minors; credited with fuelling homophobic hate crimes
leads.detail: Text cites: 'In 2013, Russia passed a law criminalising the distribution of "propaganda" promoting "non-traditional sexual relationships" among minors'. No URL visible.

leads.title: 2022 expansion of propaganda law
leads.documents: Expands 2013 law to anyone regardless of age and prohibits materials making minors interested in gender transitions; directly relevant to transgender status
leads.detail: Text cites: 'in 2022, the "propaganda" law was expanded to apply to anyone regardless of age group, and to also prohibit the distribution of materials that make minors interested in gender transitions.' No URL visible.

leads.title: July 2023 federal law banning gender transition
leads.documents: Prohibits both gender-affirming surgery and legal gender recognition outright; core transgender legal-status law applicable in Karachay-Cherkessia as federal subject
leads.detail: Text cites: 'In July 2023, Russia enacted a law banning gender transition which prohibited both gender-affirming surgery and legal gender recognition outright.' No URL visible.

leads.title: Supreme Court of Russia ruling November 2023 + 22 March 2024 unified list entry
leads.documents: Designates 'the international LGBT public movement' / 'international LGBT social movement and its structural units' as extremist/terrorist; criminalizes participation, funding, display of symbols like rainbow flag
leads.detail: Text cites: 'In November 2023, the Supreme Court issued a ruling designating "the international LGBT public movement" as an extremist group' and 'On 22 March 2024... formally added to the "unified list of terrorist and extremist organizations and persons".' No URL visible.

leads.title: European Court of Human Rights - Fedotova and Others v. Russia (2021)
leads.documents: Ruled it was human-rights violation for Russia not to offer any form of legal recognition to same-sex relationships; documents unions/recognition status
leads.detail: Text cites: 'In the 2021 case Fedotova and Others v. Russia, the European Court of Human Rights in Strasbourg ruled...' No URL visible.

leads.title: United Nations Human Rights Council expert panel report - 13 April 2017
leads.documents: Panel of five expert advisors condemned wave of torture and killings of gay men in Chechnya; documents enforcement/incidents in North Caucasus region
leads.detail: Text cites: 'In a report issued on 13 April 2017, a panel of five expert advisors to the United Nations Human Rights Council condemned the wave of torture and killings of gay men in Chechnya.' No URL visible.

leads.title: Organization for Security and Cooperation in Europe (OSCE) report - December 2018
leads.documents: Confirmed claims that persecution of LGBTQ persons had taken place and was ignored by authorities; institutional verification of enforcement failure
leads.detail: Text cites: 'A report released in December 2018 by the Organization for Security and Cooperation in Europe (OSCE) confirmed claims that persecution of LGBTQ persons had taken place and was ignored by authorities.' No URL visible.

leads.title: Moscow City Court ruling - August 2012 (Moscow Pride ban)
leads.documents: Upheld ruling blocking Moscow Pride permits yearly through 2012 citing public disorder; documents judicial enforcement of assembly bans despite 2010 ECHR ruling
leads.detail: Text cites: 'In August 2012, contravening the previous ruling, the Moscow City Court upheld a ruling blocking requests by the organisers of Moscow Pride for permits...' No URL visible.

leads.title: ILGA-Europe Rainbow ranking 2024 (and 2016 rating)
leads.documents: Ranked Russia worst out of 49 European countries surveyed for LGBTQ rights in 2024; rated second least LGBTQ-friendly in 2016; institutional rights-machinery assessment
leads.detail: Text cites: 'In 2024, the status of LGBTQ rights in Russia was ranked the worst out of the 49 countries surveyed within Europe' and 'In 2016, Russia was rated the second least LGBTQ-friendly nation in Europe by ILGA-Europe.' No URL visible.
